criteria.criterion: Navigating to a non-existent URL returns HTTP 404 status (not 200) while rendering the styled content.
criteria.evidence: Playwright response.status() = 404 for GET https://rapid-formations-clone-jwwotz6ch-bsq-group.vercel.app/this-path-does-not-exist-t30-qa/. criteria.criterion: No new console errors introduced (e.g. next/image localPatterns violations) on the 404 page.
criteria.evidence: Only one browser console message captured across all 5 page loads (1 desktop + 4 breakpoints): 'Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 ()' -- this is the browser's own network log for the top-level navigation request to the intentionally-nonexistent test path itself (expected on any 404 page test, confirmed via curl -skI returning HTTP/2 404 for the same URL), not a resource/image/hydration error. No next/image warnings, no localPatterns violations, no React hydration errors, no other console.error or pageerror events. The 404 illustration image itself returned 200 OK on GET (verified via curl) and the source uses the `unoptimized` prop on next/image (confirmed by reading src/components/shared/NotFoundContent/NotFoundContent.tsx line 36), which sidesteps the Next.js image-optimizer localPatterns check entirely.
